name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Operations Program Manager | Systems, Workflow & Cross-Functional Delivery
summary: Marketing operations and systems builder with 15+ years bringing structure to fast-moving, cross-functional teams - process design, workflow documentation, and clean reporting that keeps distributed work visible and on track. Sold and implemented project-management/PSA software before building marketing operations systems myself, giving genuine fluency on both sides of the intake-to-delivery workflow. Comfortable as the connective tissue between teams: translating ambiguous requests into scoped, tracked work and keeping stakeholders informed without noise.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping project records auditable across concurrent engagements.

Design, implement, and optimize marketing automation and CRM systems for B2B service clients as a fractional operations/implementation manager, translating business requirements into structured, trackable workflows.
Build reusable process infrastructure and internal tooling integrating with client CRMs and CMS platforms, reducing reliance on ad hoc, tribal-knowledge handoffs.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' generalized ideas and feedback into precise, structured requirements and execution plans - acting as the bridge between business intent and delivered work.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and strategic recommendations, backed by rigorous tracking across sales enablement, marketing, and operations.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, and campaign ROI, delivering structured, repeatable status updates to business-owner stakeholders.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed integrated digital marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content, coordinating execution across internal departments as strategic lead.
Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.
Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction across a 15-20 partner portfolio.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built and refined internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment.
Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication.

bullets: Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Led onboarding and launch operations as team lead and primary strategic contact, delivering launches on time and accelerating time-to-value.

Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team to execute against.
Guided client onboarding and workflow design, troubleshooting process gaps and resolving technical challenges during setup.
